nodes.summary: An infinite word $w = w_0 w_1 w_2 \cdots$ over the alphabet $\{0, 1, 3, 4\}$ avoids PVHH-cubes (additive cubes) if there are no natural numbers $s$ and $\ell \ge 1$ such that the three consecutive factors $w_s \cdots w_{s+\ell-1}$, $w_{s+\ell} \cdots w_{s+2\ell-1}$ and $w_{s+2\ell} \cdots w_{s+3\ell-1}$ of length $\ell$ all have the same sum of letter values.
nodes.title: Avoiding additive cubes

nodes.title: The Cassaigne–Currie–Schaeffer–Shallit word avoids additive cubes

nodes.title: Additive-cube-free fixed point conjecture

nodes.summary: For an infinite word $w = w_0 w_1 w_2 \cdots$ over the alphabet $\{0, 1, 3, 4\}$ and natural numbers $s$ and $\ell$, the sum of the factor of length $\ell$ starting at position $s$ is the integer $\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1} w_{s+i}$, where each letter counts as its value.
nodes.title: Sum of a factor

nodes.summary: Let $\sigma$ be the substitution $0 \mapsto 03$, $1 \mapsto 43$, $3 \mapsto 1$, $4 \mapsto 01$ on the alphabet $\{0, 1, 3, 4\}$, extended to words by replacing each letter with its image. An infinite word $w = w_0 w_1 w_2 \cdots$ over $\{0, 1, 3, 4\}$ is the fixed point generated from $0$ if the word $\sigma^k(0)$ is a prefix of $w$ for every $k \ge 0$.
nodes.title: The fixed point generated from $0$

nodes.summary: Each letter of the alphabet $\{0, 1, 3, 4\}$ has as its value the integer it names: the letters $0$, $1$, $3$ and $4$ have values $0$, $1$, $3$ and $4$.
nodes.title: Value of a letter

nodes.summary: The alphabet with four distinct letters, written $0$, $1$, $3$ and $4$.
nodes.title: The alphabet $\{0, 1, 3, 4\}$

nodes.summary: For $k \ge 0$, the word $\sigma^k(0)$ obtained from the one-letter word $0$ by applying the substitution $\sigma$ ($0 \mapsto 03$, $1 \mapsto 43$, $3 \mapsto 1$, $4 \mapsto 01$) $k$ times, where $\sigma$ acts on a word by replacing each letter with its image: $\sigma^0(0) = 0$ and $\sigma^{k+1}(0) = \sigma(\sigma^k(0))$.
nodes.title: Iterates of the substitution on $0$

nodes.summary: The map sending each letter of the alphabet $\{0, 1, 3, 4\}$ to a word: $0$ to $03$, $1$ to $43$, $3$ to $1$ and $4$ to $01$.
nodes.title: The substitution $0 \mapsto 03$, $1 \mapsto 43$, $3 \mapsto 1$, $4 \mapsto 01$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
